figs.name: allen-bradley-plc-family-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose MicroLogix, CompactLogix or ControlLogix Allen Bradley PLC
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to size an Allen Bradley PLC: ControlLogix for large redundant plants, CompactLogix for growing machines and MicroLogix for legacy panels.
figs.after_h2: How to choose the right Allen-Bradley PLC
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to choose the right Allen Bradley PLC family</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>

<rect x="250" y="56" width="300" height="50" rx="10" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="87.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Define the application</text>
<line x1="400" y1="106" x2="400" y2="124" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>

<text x="400" y="175.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Large plant, distributed</text>
<text x="400" y="196.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">or redundancy needed?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="180" x2="610" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="168" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="612" y="140" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#881337" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="174.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ControlLogix</text>
<text x="697.0" y="197.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">rack, redundant</text>
<line x1="400" y1="235" x2="400" y2="262" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="254" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,265.0 570.0,320 400,375.0 230.0,320" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="315.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">New or growing machine</text>
<text x="400" y="336.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">or production line?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="320" x2="610" y2="320" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="308" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="612" y="280" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#be123c" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.0" y="314.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">CompactLogix</text>
<text x="697.0" y="337.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">scalable</text>
<line x1="400" y1="375" x2="400" y2="402" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="394" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="220" y="402" width="360" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="431.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Small standalone machine</text>
<text x="400.0" y="455.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or existing legacy panel</text>
<line x1="400" y1="472" x2="400" y2="490" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="290" y="490" width="220" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="512.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">MicroLogix</text>
<text x="400.0" y="535.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">maintain legacy</text>
<rect x="20" y="140" width="200" height="220" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="196.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Also check</text>
<text x="120.0" y="220.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I/O count</text>
<text x="120.0" y="244.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">networking</text>
<text x="120.0" y="268.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">motion, safety</text>
<text x="120.0" y="292.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">expansion</text>
<text x="120.0" y="316.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">lifecycle</text>
</svg>

figs.name: allen-bradley-plc-families-comparison-infographic
figs.alt: Allen Bradley PLC types comparison MicroLogix vs CompactLogix vs ControlLogix

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<rect x="20" y="120" width="760" height="64" fill="#fff1f2"/>
